mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate compresses discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate lower borrowing costs and increased liquidity.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods with FEDFUNDS declining for 3 consecutive months, or Rank IC over 5-year rolling window falls below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 5.0% for two consecutive months signals labor market weakness that reduces consumer spending confidence, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as earnings expectations decline.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances with UNRATE > 5.0% for two months, or Rank IC over 5-year window remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts and retail sales growth signal broad consumer demand contraction, driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate earnings face pressure.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods with both HOUST and RSAFS declining for two months, or Rank IC over 5-year window falls below 0.04.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle expansions, industrial production exceeding 115.0 index level signals robust manufacturing activity that supports corporate profit growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of late-cycle expansions with INDPRO > 115.0, or Rank IC over 5-year window falls below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained 3-month growth in non-farm payrolls indicates strengthening labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods with PAYEMS increasing for three consecutive months, or Rank IC over 5-year window falls below 0.04.

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year CPI inflation exceeding 3.0% triggers central bank tightening expectations that depress equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances with CPIAUCSL y/y > 3.0%, or Rank IC over 5-year window falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in retail sales and declines in federal funds rate signal strong consumer demand and accommodative monetary policy, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods with RSAFS increasing and FEDFUNDS declining for two months, or Rank IC over 5-year window falls below 0.04.

mechanism_narrative: During housing market recovery, housing starts exceeding 1850.0 thousand units signals renewed residential construction activity that boosts related sectors, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of housing market recovery periods with HOUST > 1850.0, or Rank IC over 5-year window falls below 0.05.
